lore_anchors.definition: In the cultivation world of *RMJI*, a title referring to a demonic-path Patriarch of the Chaotic Star Sea, known for blood-based techniques.
A legendary Yang-attributed spirit creature whose flame is the natural bane of Yin ghosts and demonic entities.
A lightning-type energy inherent to the Golden Lightning Bamboo, highly effective against dark and demonic beings.
A blood-aligned protective technique associated with a specific demonic-path lineage; its appearance can identify a cultivator’s sect or master.
An advanced technique that splits a cultivator’s consciousness, allowing independent control of multiple magical tools or puppets.
